description_expanded: Tucked beneath a canopy of mature trees in the quiet, lakefront Mar-a-Lago community of Seagrove Beach , Lily Pad now welcomes guests with a freshly reimagined ground-floor bunk retreat that sets the tone for fun, flexible stays. This three-story coastal home offers 3 bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms, and comfortable accommodations for up to 12 guests, with thoughtful updates designed to enhance both style and functionality. South of Scenic 30A and just minutes from the shoreline, it’s an inviting escape where relaxed beach days and easy living come naturally. The second floor serves as the heart of the home, where sunlight filters through oversized windows and an open-concept layout encourages connection. A plush seating area flows into a dining space for eight and a fully equipped kitchen featuring granite countertops, stainless-steel appliances, and a farmhouse sink that makes both cooking and gathering feel effortless. Step out onto the shaded balcony to enjoy peaceful views overlooking the community pool and a tranquil coastal dune lake, where gentle breezes and the rustle of trees create a serene backdrop for morning coffee or unwinding after a day at the beach. Downstairs, the reimagined bunk room has been thoughtfully designed as both a sleeping space and a built-in entertainment hub. Two full-over-full bunk beds provide plenty of room for kids, teens, or additional guests, while a pair of classic arcade games adds a playful, nostalgic touch that invites hours of friendly competition. Comfortable lounge chairs and a wall-mounted flatscreen create the perfect setup for movie nights or winding down after a day in the sun, all complemented by a beautifully updated bathroom that brings a fresh, polished feel to the space. Each bedroom is intentionally positioned across all three levels to provide privacy while maintaining a cohesive sense of comfort. The first-floor bunk suite offers direct outdoor access, making it easy to transition from poolside afternoons to evening relaxation. On the third floor, two serene king suites each feature private balconies on opposite sides of the home, offering distinct and equally inviting perspectives. One overlooks the community pool and tranquil lake, with a subtle peek of the Gulf shimmering through the treetops. The other gazes out over windswept trees with distant glimpses of the lake, complete with a charming café table—an ideal spot to sip wine and soak in the quiet. Both bedrooms include en-suite bathrooms with shower/tub combinations, perfect for unwinding after sun-filled days. A private gas grill invites casual cookouts, while access to the community pool adds another layer of laid-back enjoyment under the Florida sun. Lily Pad is located just a scenic 6-minute walk (approximately 0.4 miles) from Eastern Lake Beach Access, where wide sands and the emerald waters of the Gulf await—no stairs required. Spend your days paddleboarding on Eastern Lake, biking along 30A’s winding paths with the complimentary bikes, or heading to nearby favorites like Old Florida Fish House for a relaxed meal. With Seaside, Grayton Beach, and Rosemary Beach all within easy reach, you’re perfectly positioned to experience the best of 30A while returning home to a setting that feels peaceful, shaded, and distinctly inviting. Whether you’re cruising to coffee, stretching out on the sand, or gathering on the balcony beneath the trees, Lily Pad invites you to slow down and savor the rhythm of Seagrove Beach. First Floor: Guest Bedroom with 2 Full/Full Bunk Beds and Private Bathroom + Shower/Tub Combo. Second Floor: Living Room with Balcony Access, Dining, Kitchen, Laundry, Powder Room Third Floor: King Bedroom with Shower/Tub Combo, King Bedroom with Shower/Tub Combo.
